description: This file defines an interface 'TokenInterface' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying methods for managing AWS access tokens.
external_files: Amazon Web Services SDK for PHP

classes.name: TokenInterface
classes.description: An interface that provides a contract for AWS token objects, including methods to retrieve the token, expiration time, check expiry, and convert to array.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the token string used for AWS service access.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Returns the UNIX timestamp when the token expires, or null if it does not expire.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the current token is expired.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the token object to an associative array.
